images.label: CorridorRevelation
images.prompt: A rain-soaked, dimly lit hospital corridor at 3:17 AM; flickering fluorescent ceiling lights cast stuttering shadows; a lone forensic investigator in a dark trench coat stands before an open morgue drawer, revealing a corpse with a faintly glowing crimson vertical line pulsing on its chest; cyberpunk/sci-fi style, tight medium shot, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting with cold blue ambient tones and localized warm red bioluminescent glow from the 'bloodline'; shallow depth of field, cinematic realism, volumetric mist and rain-streaked glass in background.

images.label: EarFissure
images.prompt: Extreme close-up of a man's left ear and nape: a 3cm dried dark-brown bloodline fissure pulses faintly beneath pale skin, surrounded by subtle moisture droplets and microscopic crystalline residue; sci-fi medical thriller style, macro photography composition, dramatic side-lit illumination with cool clinical white light and a soft internal ruby glow emanating from the fissure; shallow focus, hyper-detailed skin texture, visible capillaries and micro-hair follicles, sterile metallic background blur suggesting a morgue wall.

images.label: TwelveLines
images.prompt: Twelve morgue drawers simultaneously ajar in a sterile steel-lined morgue; each exposed corpse lies supine with a uniquely sized but identically vibrating crimson bioluminescent line across the sternum; overhead industrial lights blaze harshly, casting sharp black shadows; cyberpunk/sci-fi style, wide-angle symmetrical composition, stark fluorescent lighting mixed with rhythmic 12.7Hz pulse-glow from all lines; shallow DOF emphasizing front three corpses, background drawers receding into cool gray gradient; silent tension, no human figures visible, only humming machinery glow reflected on stainless surfaces.
